name: Pet Cone Pet Recovery Collar – X-Small (7.5cm)
shortDescription: Help your pet recover safely and comfortably with the Pet Cone Recovery Collar X-Small (7.5cm) . Designed for small dogs, cats, kittens, puppies, and rabbits, this lightweight recovery collar prevents pets from licking, scratching, biting, or aggravating wounds, stitches, rashes, and surgical sites during the healing process.
description: Made from durable yet lightweight material, this protective Elizabethan collar provides reliable coverage while allowing your pet to eat, drink, sleep, and move around comfortably. The adjustable fastening system ensures a secure fit, helping to keep the collar in place throughout recovery. Ideal for post-surgery care, injury management, skin conditions, and wound protection, this cone collar is an essential recovery aid for pet owners seeking a safe and effective healing solution. Key Features X-Small size (7.5cm) suitable for small pets Helps prevent licking, biting, and scratching of wounds Ideal for post-surgery recovery and injury protection Lightweight design for enhanced comfort Adjustable fit for secure wear Durable and easy-to-clean material Allows pets to eat, drink, and rest comfortably Suitable for cats, small dog breeds, puppies, kittens, and rabbits Benefits The Pet Cone Recovery Collar promotes faster healing by preventing pets from interfering with wounds or surgical sites. Its comfortable, lightweight construction minimizes stress while providing effective protection during recovery. Size: X-Small (7.5cm) Suitable For: Cats, kittens, puppies, small dogs, and rabbits Use: Post-surgery recovery, wound care, skin conditions, hot spots, and injury protection.
